description: Use before writing or fixing actdiag activity diagrams for render_diagram (format actdiag): rules checked against the renderer, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier: Node names are the key and `label` is the display text: `n0002 [label = "engine"];` then use `n0002` in edges. Node attributes go inside the lane: `lane srv { n0002 [label = "check"]; }`. Never invent identifiers.
